info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Replace Market Data Financial Instrument Reference Data Management-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the management and updating of financial instrument reference data within the banking sector. It allows businesses to ensure that their market data remains accurate and up-to-date, which is crucial for effective financial analytics and decision-making. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, investment firms, and fintech companies looking to maintain up-to-date reference data for trading and risk management purposes. By utilizing this endpoint, users can update existing financial instrument records seamlessly, supporting operational efficiency and compliance.

put.description: Allows users to update existing financial instrument reference data in the market data system. This operation is essential for maintaining accurate and up-to-date information about financial instruments, ensuring that all operations reliant on this data function correctly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the financial instrument reference data in the market data system. Ensure that the provided data adheres to the schema specifications.

200.description: Request completed successfully; the financial instrument reference data has been updated.
